purpose: Gap Challenger (pipeline/gap_challenger.py, Clinova Phase 3 Epic 3.4) regression cases -- real, independently-verified known-open/known-closed/ambiguous research questions, distinct from evals/benchmarks/v1's pipeline-bug fixtures. Feeds Phase 4's entry trigger (10-phased-implementation-plan.md: "Phase 3's Gap Challenger is benchmark-regression-tested").
format_note: Deliberately lightweight compared to v1's full wiki/graph fixtures: one gap object + a verified ground-truth status class + real citations. Run via evals/benchmarks/v2/run_gap_challenger_benchmark.py -- these are live-API cases (real search + LLM judgment calls), not part of the mocked `tests/` unittest suite, matching this project's existing convention that evals/benchmarks/ scripts are run by hand, not via pytest.
note: Unlike v1, NOT marked immutable -- the format itself may still need adjustment as new case classes are added. Epic 4.3 Bucket C (2026-08-24) added three new ground_truth_status_class values beyond closed_leaning/open_leaning: 'fabricated' (a constructed, literature-unsupported gap claim -- expected to expose a real pipeline weakness, not pass a test; see that case's expected_current_behavior field), 'ambiguous' (a real, currently-contested question with genuinely disagreeing sources, distinct from open_leaning's 'nobody has studied this yet'), and 'contradictory_pair' (a real, DOI-verified pair of papers reaching opposite conclusions, carrying an additional known_contradicting_pair field). run_gap_challenger_benchmark.py's _ACCEPTABLE_STATUSES and verdict logic were extended accordingly. Will be reconsidered once the case set stabilizes.
